basic_info.description: Located on one of the highest points in San Francisco, this semi-detached home in the Miraloma neighborhood offers incredible views that extend across the San Francisco Bay. Just completed updates, including fresh paint, refinished oak floors, new lighting, and an all-new kitchen. Adding even more to the appeal is an approved and paid-for permit already in place, offering a tremendous advantage to any buyer planning for future expansion. This permit allows for remodeling, expansion, and conversion of the unfinished spaces, saving significant time and effort in the process. With this, the home could be transformed into an approximately 2,500 square-foot residence with fully approved plans, providing ample space to customize to personal tastes, while bypassing the lengthy approval process that often comes with such a project. The current home offers on the street level an attached garage with adjoining unfinished space and access to a covered view deck with free-standing spa, plus there is an unfinished basement level and a lower yard with fruit trees. Nearby, Mount Davidson Park and Glen Canyon Park offer hiking trails, tennis courts, and playgrounds. The neighborhood boasts convenient access to Glen Park BART, local shopping, dining, and highly regarded schools.
